people.name: Mephibosheth
people.line: Son of Jonathan and grandson of King Saul.

people.name: Micah
people.line: Son of Mephibosheth, grandson of Jonathan.

people.name: Ziba
people.line: Servant of Saul's household, later served David

translations.web: Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. All that lived in Ziba’s house were servants to Mephibosheth.
translations.bsb: And Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica, and all who dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants of Mephibosheth.
translations.kjv: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.
translations.asv: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Mica. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.
